description: Lease up to `limit` (1-100, default 100) oldest-first pending inbox messages for processing (default 300s lease, 1-600s). Ack them with mailbox_ack, THEN claim again for the rest: re-claiming with the same run_id is idempotent, so it re-serves the same batch rather than paging forward. A foreign run cannot steal a live lease; expired leases are reclaimable. Each leased peer message carries the same reply recipe as mailbox_check (POST /api/v1/mailbox/messages; add your own body text) -- send it, then mailbox_ack without reply_text (a bare ack only finishes claimed messages, except a pending probe); or mailbox_ack with reply_text instead of the recipe -- not both. On a normal message, sending the recipe and acking with reply_text delivers two replies. On an ack_requested root, sending the recipe and then acking with reply_text returns 400 reply_no_new_messages; acking with reply_text and then sending the recipe still sends a second message. System notices and rows with no sender id have reply null. Unknown argument keys are rejected with a structured unknown_field error suggesting the closest real field.

inputSchema.description:
Lease pending messages for the caller's own mailbox (``mailbox_claim``).

Strict-fields loop: unknown argument keys 422 as a structured
``unknown_field`` error.

lease_seconds.description: Lease duration (1-600s; expired leases are reclaimable).
lease_seconds.title: Lease Seconds

limit.description: Lease at most this many messages (1-100, default 100), oldest-first — a bounded slice of the backlog instead of the whole head.
limit.title: Limit

message_ids.description: Lease JUST these messages (1-100 ids) — a targeted reply to one peer without draining the backlog (the reply rides the ack, and the ack only delivers when the acked set has exactly one sender). Ids you cannot lease are skipped, not errors.
message_ids.title: Message Ids

run_id.description: Optional lease owner id: re-claiming with the same run_id is idempotent; a foreign run cannot steal a live lease.
run_id.title: Run Id

inputSchema.title: MailboxClaimInput

name: mailbox_claim
